prose: The Marvelous DeMystifiers return to continue exploring the vast depth of symbolism in Marvel's Loki television series. Picking up at Season 2, episode 2, called Breaking Brad, we explore the encoding of the High Priestess and Lovers cards of the Major Arcana, the endless gematria riddles hiding in the show, more disclosure of the TVA Tavistock controlled counter-culture creation that supports the "sacred timeline" of modern society, and much more.
